question: P, L,K, U, J and Y went for a trip to Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh in six consecutive months of the same calendar year. P preferred to visit Rajasthan in the month of November. U visited Uttar Pradesh exactly two months prior to P. Y preferred the month of July. J preferred to visit Rajasthan exactly between the months preferred by Y and U. L visited exactly one month prior to Y. In which month did K visit?
